recipes.name: Rice-moong homemade feed
recipes.source: rn4kids PRINT course homemade feed (rice flour 20 g, moong dal flour 10 g, sugar 10 g, oil 5 g, water 150 mL); course states about 170 kcal and 4 to 5 g protein.

ingredients.note: Moong dal flour; IFCT green gram dal used.
Any vegetable oil; groundnut oil used.

recipes.name: Roti, atta (example, calibrate per household)
recipes.source: Example. Weigh the atta used for a known number of rotis in each household and replace these values.

recipes.name: Moong dal, plain, no salt (example, calibrate per household)
recipes.source: Example. Weigh the raw ingredients and the cooked pot in each household and replace these values.
